title: Add per-user BMI/TDEE UI and rename branding to Calorieshivam

requirements.summary: Extend the post-login profile setup UI to collect height, age, sex, and activity level and persist them with the existing per-user profile.
acceptanceCriteria: The profile setup UI includes inputs for height, age, sex, and activity level in addition to the existing name/body-goal fields.
Form validation prevents saving clearly invalid values (e.g., non-positive height/age).
Submitting the setup form persists the new fields along with the existing profile fields via the existing profile-save hook.
All user-facing text in the profile setup dialog is in English and does not reference old app names (e.g., remove/replace the existing “Welcome to NutriScan!” text).

file_operations.description: Add controlled inputs for height (cm), age, sex, and activity level, validate values (required + positive ranges), and include the new fields (heightCm, age, sex, activityLevel) when calling the existing useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation. Also update the dialog title/description to English branding-neutral copy (no “NutriScan”). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update the profile-completeness gating logic so the post-login setup flow continues until the required BMI/TDEE inputs (heightCm, age, sex, activityLevel) are present in addition to existing name/bodyGoal checks. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a persistent Maintenance Calories (TDEE) + BMI dashboard section that reacts to today’s entries and prompts for missing profile inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows a clearly visible card/section with TDEE (maintenance calories) and BMI for logged-in users.
The section indicates Above/Below/At maintenance based on today’s total calories vs TDEE, including the difference in kcal.
If the user profile lacks required fields for calculation, the section renders an English call-to-action message instead of broken/blank values.
The section updates correctly as today’s entries change (reactive to existing today totals).

file_operations.description: Create a React Query hook that calls the backend capability actor.getCallerHealthMetrics and caches the result for the authenticated user; ensure it is enabled only when the actor is available. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a dashboard card component that displays: TDEE, today’s consumed calories, Above/Below/At maintenance with kcal difference, and BMI with category label. If required profile fields are missing, render an English prompt listing which fields are needed (derive missing fields from the current UserProfile shape). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new MaintenanceCaloriesCard into the dashboard in a clearly visible location for logged-in users; pass today’s total calories (existing memoized totals) and the current user profile; integrate the useCallerHealthMetrics hook for BMI/TDEE display and keep the card reactive as todayEntries change. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Rename all user-facing branding to “Calorieshivam” across the web app UI and Android wrapper without changing technical identifiers.
acceptanceCriteria: Web app header brand text displays “Calorieshivam”.
Login page displays “Calorieshivam” and any logo alt text reflects the new name.
Browser tab title in `frontend/index.html` uses “Calorieshivam” and keeps the rest of the title text in English.
Footer text no longer references “Calorieman” and uses “Calorieshivam”.
Android wrapper `app_name` string is “Calorieshivam” and wrapper README heading/content references “Calorieshivam” where it is a user-facing app name.
No required build changes rename technical identifiers like the Android package (`com/nutriscan/wrapper`) unless needed to compile.

file_operations.description: Update the header brand label text to “Calorieshivam” and update the logo image alt text to reflect the new name. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update login page title text to “Calorieshivam” and update the logo image alt text to “Calorieshivam”; ensure all user-facing strings remain English. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update the footer copyright line to “Calorieshivam” and ensure it no longer references “Calorieman”; keep the rest of the footer English. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Update the browser tab title to start with “Calorieshivam” while keeping the rest of the title text in English.
Change the user-facing app_name string to “Calorieshivam”; update any user-facing comments that mention the old app name while keeping technical keys (e.g., nutriscan_base_url) unchanged.
Update README heading and user-facing references from “Calorieman” to “Calorieshivam” (do not rename technical identifiers unless required for build correctness).
Update the Android wrapper rootProject.name to “Calorieshivam” to match the user-facing wrapper name (keep package/applicationId unchanged).
